newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB says to cut June debenture coupon to 2.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: LTCB says to cut June debenture coupon to 2.4 pct.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) said on Tuesday it would cut the coupon rate of its June five-year bank debenture to 2.4 percent from 2.5 percent in May.
LTCB also said it would cut its long-term prime lending rate for June to 2.9 percent from 3.1 percent in May.
The new long-term prime rate will go into effect on Wednesday.
The 0.1 percentage point cut in the June debenture's coupon rate "appropriately" reflected current market conditions, an LTCB spokesman said.
LTCB's May five-year debentures with a coupon rate of 2.5 percent were traded at 2.45 percent on Monday, bond traders said.
On Monday, the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd said it would cut its long-term prime rate to 2.9 percent in June from 3.1 percent in May.
IBJ also said it would cut the coupon rate for its benchmark five-year debentures to be issued in June to two percent from the May issue's 2.2 percent.
The prime rate, which is applied to loans of one year and longer to Japanese long-term credit banks' most creditworthy clients, is reviewed every month, reflecting market trends.

The prime rate, which is also a key reference rate for other banks making long-term loans, was raised by 0.6 percentage percentage point to 3.1 percent in May from a record-low 2.5 percent the month before.
